MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 22
   C. 16
   D. 55

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/2

3. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

4. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

5. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 24.5
   C. 7
   D. 8

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 75
   B. 20
   C. 30
   D. 40

7. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

8. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.025

9. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27.7
   C. 27
   D. 33

10. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

11. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 31.6
   D. 37

12. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
